title: I've been improving my Online multiplayer Arcade Shooter based on your feedback! "INFEST: The Arcade Game" now has a playable browser demo + Team Deathmatch!!
author: Illustrious-Lake2603
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

Welcome back to **INFEST: The Arcade Game!** 🐜🚀

First off, I want to thank everyone who has shared feedback so far! I've been listening to your suggestions and working hard to improve the game.

**You can now play INFEST directly in your browser!** No downloads required! 🎮

ONLINE IS HERE!!!!

Thanks to GPT Sol 6.1(i did this before 6.2 came out) and Opus 5.5 we were able to search, buy purchase a domain name, rent a VPS server, and hook everything up for the game! We are living some surreal times! 

For the quick breakdown of the cost:

|Purchase|Cost|
|:-|:-|
|[`xbclabs.com`](http://xbclabs.com) domain — one year|$11.17|
|OVHcloud server — first month|$5.35|
|Website and press kit hosting|$0|
|**Total**|**$16.52**|

In my opinion I feel like $6 a month to get my Multiplayer game running is actually amazing. And a $11.17 once a year fee is good too. Overall I am glad of the price, but Lets see how well it holds up in the real world...  


Now for the Online game!

**🌐 Multiplayer Modes:**

* ⚔️ Team Deathmatch
* 💀 Free-for-All Deathmatch
* 🚩 Capture the Flag
* 🦠 Infection

**And here's where I could really use your help!**

I'm am trying to make INFEST the best game it can be, and I'd genuinely love to hear your thoughts.

What feels fun? What feels frustrating? Is there anything that needs more polish? Are there features you'd love to see added?

**Don't hold back on the constructive criticism!** Whether it's the gameplay, movement, weapons, graphics, or UI, your feedback helps shape the future of INFEST.

🎮 **Play the free demo:** [https://panic-blazeit.itch.io/infest-the-arcade](https://panic-blazeit.itch.io/infest-the-arcade)

Thanks for giving my little project a chance. I hope you have fun with it! ❤️

(\*NOTE: I had to compress some of the graphics to get the WebGL version running smoothly, but the downloadable Windows version features the full-quality visuals and better overall performance.**)**

comments.author: ArtificialBeingsInc
comments.body: Your demo page mentions filling empty seats with bots, so I'd track real players and bots separately when testing the $5.35 server. Bots may exercise the game logic without producing the same network traffic as remote players. Try a small session where players join and respawn together, then compare CPU/RAM, network use and player latency at different player counts. If available, server tick time would help distinguish a busy server from a slow client. I haven't played the demo yet, so that's a suggested test, not a performance finding.

replies.author: Illustrious-Lake2603
replies.body: Thank you for this! I will need to do further tests exactly how much this server can handle
